item.text: Reconstructed all 24 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording and repetitions in `romanLyrics`. Both versions align line for line, with an opening and two numbered stanzas. I read “Choda so” as چودہ سو, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.
